scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.prebuild: cd apps/api && node prisma/set-provider.js && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:admin && npm run build:merchant && npm run build:portal && npm run build:launcher
scripts.build:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');function copyDir(src,dest){if(!fs.existsSync(dest))fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})){const s=p.join(src,e.name),d=p.join(dest,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())copyDir(s,d);else fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}copyDir('apps/api/dist','dist');console.log('Copied apps/api/dist to dist/')"
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:studio: cd apps/api && npm run prisma:set-provider && npx prisma studio
